title: Three Friends Fishing Hole
identified: 2026-10-20, added to the repo when Daniel asked for every fish artifact in the app folder
what: One-page guide to Three Friends Fishing Hole, a Green River bank spot in Kent by the S 212th St rule line: Chinook closure notice, coho/chum run-timing grid, best times, lower Green rules, sources. The same place is stop 1 on the Green in Artifacts/fishing-year/seasons.json.
note: Published as spots/ inside the Washington Fishing Map (Artifacts/salmon-rivers/spots/), which carries the shared tab bar. This URL is the MAIN page: never publish this folder's index.html to it. Single hand-written page, no data files. Its dated rules (limits, S 212th St openings, Chinook closure) are from WDFW rule 26-155 and eRegulations as of Oct 19, 2026 and go stale; check them against Fishing Year before republishing. To refresh, edit Artifacts/salmon-rivers/spots/index.html and publish the main URL with file_path=Artifacts/salmon-rivers/index.html and files={"spots/index.html": "Artifacts/salmon-rivers/spots/index.html"}.
